data.body: MERGED as commit 2e2fe3f7d (Gerrit change 968), LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1. Every AC met: (1) with the suite on the attested default, committing a change to a signed dependency file blocks the claim naming drift (test_code_drift_in_dependency_file_invalidates + test_attested_claim_gate_sees_committed_drift_in_signed_dependency); (2) an unrelated committed change does not invalidate (test_attested_claim_gate_ignores_unrelated_committed_change + existing worm-folly-barge test); (3) deletion of a signed dependency invalidates; (4) the drift-refresh path works under attested semantics (drift tests commit their drift via _commit_all); (5) the manifest.py back-out prose and ADR 0002 S4b were amended to say the boundary guarantees consistent resolution SEMANTICS, not identical bases, and local-mode wording is reconciled with 5128's never-sign rule; (6) lint/typecheck/full suite green (7163 passed locally; Verified +1 on the change tree). Landing also carried: the suite-wide sandbox REBAR_ROOT default (fallout of the attested default exposing unsandboxed tests), and the ws4 module pin that fixed the CI-lane hang (root cause faulthandler-proven: ambient-checkout attested resolve -> materialize_tickets -> git checkout-index lazy-fetching on CI's shallow+blobless clone). Product-level hardening for that lazy-fetch hang is filed separately as 747f-d1ba (cautious-defamatory-verdin, discovered_from this ticket); the tracker-symlink leak fix landed earlier as dd62-2791 (change 972).
